sections.content: You know *todavía no* with the *pretérito perfecto* from Unit 2: *Todavía no he preparado la comida*. Here you use it to answer an invitation and say that your preparations are not finished. *Todavía no* comes before *he* or *hemos*.

items.spanish: Todavía no he preparado la comida.
items.english: I have not prepared the food yet.

items.spanish: Todavía no hemos comprado la comida.
items.english: We have not bought the food yet.

items.spanish: Todavía no he aceptado la invitación.
items.english: I have not accepted the invitation yet.

sections.content: *todavía no* is one of the rare cases where Spanish maps word-for-word onto English: asked *¿Has aceptado la invitación?*, answering just *Todavía no* means exactly 'not yet' — no extra grammar to juggle.
